phase: bundle built and verified; documentation page built locally (awaiting second-agent check of the page)
scope: Local review bundle for the explicit UMich 2021 treadmill subset (44 recordings). Not completion of all UM21 tasks, not scientific approval, not published.

runner.why_not_build_dataset_release: build_dataset_release.py is in-memory and refuses inputs above 500,000 rows and a 256 MiB estimate; this bundle has 1.13 million rows, and the guard must not be raised. A small runner modeled on run_um21_q01_assessment.py streams one recording at a time and imports the Q01 assessment functions (bound by hash).

decisions_applied.how: Stride membership is the T03 task-window rule as released by T03/T04; the bundle adds no stride and removes only what the other decisions name.
The six recordings are absent from the T04 inputs, so they are absent here. D-UM21-T02-2 does not exist in the backlog (withdrawn per the fixes page); AB01 i5 is held out as that note states.

Thigh and shank are released under the standard names thigh_sagittal_angle_ipsi_rad and shank_sagittal_angle_ipsi_rad from the T04 planar recipe (hip, pelvis, knee as published after signs). Status 'jump limit only; planar estimate'. T03 thigh/shank/foot columns are not used. Foot angle and foot velocity are NOT released: D-UM21-C01-1 covers thigh and shank only, and the foot angle carries the ankle offset.

Ankle angle and hip/knee/ankle flexion moments are standard columns, values as published after T04 signs. Anomalous ankle recording-sides stay missing as T04/Q01 left them (AB08/i0 left ankle: 12 strides all-missing). Ankle angle is marked offset unverified.

Sign rule applied by T04 (pelvis tilt x -1 in 43 of 44 recordings; the other 1 is AB04/i0, see P01). Hip, knee and ankle angles and moments keep their published sign. Segment angles counterclockwise, joint angles and moments positive in their named direction.

AB07/i10 right ankle: the 22 strides the Q01 assessment flagged (22 failing L1) are exactly the released strides of the ledger's 31 inside strides (the other 9 ledger strides are not in the T04 set: not T03 observations). Re-expression c1 -> wrap(c1 + 180 deg) on all 150 samples of 20 strides; the 2 strides with sudden jumps (frames 11703:11834 and 12608:12735; census step frames inside, and a 30+ deg jump remains after re-expression) are left out of both variants; source copies untouched; every re-expressed sample logged in ankle_reexpression_log.csv (3,000 rows). Re-check with the same L1/L2 limits on the re-expressed arrays: 20 of 20 pass (assessment_amendments.jsonl); re-expressed ankle spans -16.2 to 26.8 deg vs the census p1-p99 -16.6 to 27.0 deg outside the stretch. Ledger check: 29 clean and 2 jump strides of 31 (matches the decision text). Stride-level rule used because the 150-sample table has no second Cardan component: stretch membership comes from the census run edges (which were tested per frame with |c2| > 90 deg), not re-tested here. Partial overlap check: no stride overlaps a run without lying inside it (one stride shares a single boundary frame and stays untouched; Q01 had it clean).
Applied upstream in T04 (AB04/i0 pelvis multiplier +1 instead of -1, i.e. flipped from marker evidence; thigh and shank built from it). 165 AB04/i0 strides stay (no change here).

Filtering and release facts use the one Q01 assessment (coarse limits L1, L2; structure L3, L4). Only the 20 re-expressed strides were re-assessed (amendments file); every other stride uses its Q01 entry unchanged. Moments, powers, velocities unchecked; pelvis, thigh, shank jump-only.
Copied-sign channels are published as T04 decided (4 power channel-recordings copied); nothing added here.
The 15 unmapped strides are listed in exclusions.csv with their reasons (13 under 50 frames, 2 over 250 frames) and are in neither variant.
Power sign set by correlation with published moment x joint speed (|r| >= 0.9); where that failed (8 channel-recordings) power is held: present-but-missing column, see held columns.

open_items_resolved.contralateral_columns: None. T04 publishes each stride's own leg only; the opposite leg is a separate observation with its own identity. Copying or mirroring would invent values; the older T03 contra columns pre-date the sign step and are not trusted. All column names are _ipsi_ (pelvis has no side). Reversible later by an added column family; no decision needed.
open_items_resolved.stable_column_schema: All 15 signal columns exist in every row of both variants. Held power channels (8 channel-recordings in 6 recordings) are present but all missing, and each row's held_signals JSON names them with the text 'held: sign unsettled'; held_signals.csv lists recording, column and reason. Checked: zero finite values in any held cell (T8). Consistent with DATA_CONTRACT.md: unavailable signals stay missing, column presence is not coverage, never a value.
open_items_resolved.column_naming: LocoHub reference names (docs/reference/index.md): hip_flexion_angle_ipsi_rad, knee_flexion_angle_ipsi_rad, ankle_dorsiflexion_angle_ipsi_rad, pelvis_sagittal_angle_rad, thigh/shank_sagittal_angle_ipsi_rad, *_velocity_*_rad_s, *_moment_ipsi_Nm_kg, *_power_ipsi_W_kg (the reference leaves power names dataset-specific). Raw T04 aliases are named in manifest.json column_status.t04_channel.

original_vs_fixed.original: Published task intervals were timed on the belt-speed record, not on the motion data; in 4 of 50 treadmill recordings the clock is off by 1.7 to 7 s (and 2 cannot be checked), so strides near a speed or incline change can carry the wrong task label.
original_vs_fixed.fixed: Recordings that fail the clock check are left out of this bundle (no interval is shifted or estimated). The 44 kept recordings agree within the accepted band.
original_vs_fixed.example: Recording AB09 incline 10: the best lag is 685 frames (6.85 s) and belt-speed error drops from 0.67 to 0.07 m/s at that lag, so it is left out. (A recording-level example: its strides are not in the bundle, so there is no observation ID.) Also AB01 incline 5 is an exact copy of AB01 incline 10 and is left out.

original_vs_fixed.original: In AB04 level walking the motion-capture software computed the pelvis facing backwards, so its stored tilt has the wrong sign (and thigh/shank built on it).
original_vs_fixed.fixed: For that recording only, pelvis tilt sign is flipped from marker evidence and thigh/shank are rebuilt from it; the change is logged per recording in the T04 map.
original_vs_fixed.example: um21:Streaming/AB04/Tread/i0:right:frames:1052:1211 (pelvis multiplier +1 here, -1 in the other 43 recordings).

original_vs_fixed.original: The source reports forward pelvis tilt as positive; LocoHub's counterclockwise rule makes forward tilt negative.
original_vs_fixed.fixed: Pelvis tilt x -1 in 43 of 44 recordings (all strides); hip, knee and ankle angles and flexion/dorsiflexion moments keep their published sign (checked against marker and force-plate evidence).
original_vs_fixed.example: um21:Streaming/AB01/Tread/i0:right:frames:965:1142 (pelvis x -1 from the source sign; hip, knee, ankle x +1).

original_vs_fixed.original: Pre-fix rebuild code added pelvis tilt to hip flexion, but the authors subtract it; the thigh angle was off by about twice the pelvis tilt. The older T03 columns are not trusted.
original_vs_fixed.fixed: Thigh and shank are rebuilt from published pelvis, hip and knee after signs and released as side-view (planar) estimates under standard names.

original_vs_fixed.original: For 5,429 frames of one recording's right ankle (AB07, incline 10) the software reported the ankle in an equivalent but different form that shifts it by about 180 degrees: strides sat near minus 160 degrees.
original_vs_fixed.fixed: 20 strides are converted to the standard form (angle + 180 degrees, wrapped) with all 3,000 samples logged; 2 strides with one-frame jumps are left out; the converted values fall on the recording's other strides and pass the same coarse limits.
original_vs_fixed.example: um21:Streaming/AB07/Tread/i10:right:frames:11834:11966, sample 10: -159.6 degrees as published becomes 20.4 degrees.

original_vs_fixed.original: Power is stored in two layouts (8 recordings differ) and its sign was unsettled by the hook alone.
original_vs_fixed.fixed: Power sign set so power = published moment x joint speed (correlation at least 0.9 on both legs); where that fails, power is held (present but missing).
original_vs_fixed.example: Published: um21:Streaming/AB02/Tread/d10:right:frames:2139:2258 (hip power x -1, r = -1.00). Held: AB03 incline 10 hip power (r = 0.80 / 0.67), e.g. um21:Streaming/AB03/Tread/i10:right:frames:2413:2523 has hip_flexion_power_ipsi_W_kg missing with held_signals naming it.
